source: Community-sourced from MLB.com, ESPN, USA Today, Dodgers Nation, Dodgers Blue, Braves reporting

ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

current_injury.details: Suffered a non-displaced fracture of the left fibula during Spring Training. Missed significant time in the 2025 season and into early 2026. On the 60-day injured list while rehabbing.

injury_history.details: Strained the medial collateral ligament in his left knee during a game. Missed time but returned.
Torn meniscus requiring surgery. Faced long-term concerns about his clutch-play dominance returning.
Bone bruise and contusion to the left knee. Missed time but recovered.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023. Acuña's return timeline is still uncertain. Community contributors should monitor Braves beat reporters (Journal Sentinel, MLB.com) for Rehab Gate updates.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.details: Stiff lower back causing consecutive game misses. Out 3+ games as of July 13, 2026. NOT expected to be placed on IL. Manager Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better.'

injury_history.details: Stiff lower back causing game misses. Day-to-day status. Not expected on IL.
Broken right wrist during batting practice in a freak spring training accident at Camelback Ranch. Struck by a deflected ball from a pitching machine. Sidelined 6-8 weeks.
Strain caused lineup removal and a stint on the injured list. Dave Roberts gave optimistic update as treatment improved symptoms.
Severe illness causing significant weight loss (nearly 20 lbs in two weeks). Added death of stepfather to a difficult stretch.

rehab_timeline.notes: Conservative treatment; no IL expected for back issue

mookie-betts.return_status: Day-to-Day - Expected within days, recurring issue
mookie-betts.notes: Betts' 2025-2026 has been tumultuous — broken wrist, oblique strain, severe illness, personal loss, and now recurring back issues. All major injuries have resolved. Community should update if recurring back or oblique issues worsen or if any future complications arise from the spring training pitching machine accident.

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.details: Managing chronic left ankle with occasional flare-ups. No acute injury at this time. Previous neck stinger from August 2025 has fully resolved.

injury_history.details: Late scratch from lineup vs. Cincinnati Reds. Short-lived, returned quickly.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management. Not a full absence from lineup.
Ongoing neck management reported by Dodgers coaching staff after August stinger.
Sprained right ankle late in regular season. Underwent debridement and removal of loose bodies in early December 2024. Played through injury in 2024 postseason.

rehab_timeline.notes: No active rehab. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment.

freddie-freeman.return_status: N/A - Currently active and playing regularly
freddie-freeman.notes: Freeman's chronic ankle issues (both right and left) require ongoing monitoring, especially as a first baseman placing heavy stress on lower extremities. Previous left ankle sprain in June 2025 and right ankle debridement in Dec 2024 suggest a trend. The 2025 neck stinger was minor but may recur. Community should track Dodgers beat reporters for any lineup changes.

metadata.contribution_guidelines: Fork repository, create feature branch, update injury-updates.json and/or LATEST-INFO.md, submit PR with date, details, rehab timeline, return status, and source URL. Cross-reference with official sources (MLB.com, team PRs, beat reporters).
